title: SM PSS1A
text: 离散时间或连续时间单输入 PSS1A 电力系统稳定器，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间；{Power system stabilizer (PSS) gain, K_S (pu)} 指定电力系统稳定器增益、{PSS denominator constant for second-order block, A_1} 指定滤波器常数、{PSS denominator constant for second-order block, A_2} 指定滤波器常数、{PSS numerator (lead) compensating time constant, T_1 (s)} 指定超前时间常数、{PSS denominator (lag) compensating time constant, T_2 (s)} 指定滞后时间常数、{PSS numerator (lead) compensating time constant, T_3 (s)} 指定超前时间常数、{PSS denominator (lag) compensating time constant, T_4 (s)} 指定滞后时间常数、{PSS washout time constant, T_5 (s)} 指定 Washout 时间常数、{PSS transducer time constant, T_6 (s)} 指定变送器时间常数、{Maximum PSS output, V_STmax (pu)} 指定最大稳定、{Minimum PSS output, V_STmin (pu)} 指定最小稳定，按实例取值。
